description: FREE lite cluster & consensus report for one token (Solana mint or Base contract). Top-line only: consensus score, signal, tracked buyer/seller counts, tracked net USD, canonical status and the safety band — events, holder overlap and coverage detail are capped. Use it to triage whether a token deserves the full cluster_check report.

address.description: Token address: a Solana mint (base58, e.g. Ce2gx9KGXJ6C9Mp5b5x1sn9Mg87JwEbrQby4Zqo3pump) or a Base contract (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars). Chain is auto-detected from the format.

name: cluster_check_lite
